title: Altair chart does not render correctly when created from a dictionary
body: # Summary When I create an Altair chart from a dictionary, it does not get rendered correctly in Streamlit. # Steps to reproduce [![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-1196) 1. Create a chart from a dictionary 2. Try to render it ## Expected behavior: The chart should render correctly. ## Actual behavior: The data of the chart does not get rendered. ## Is this a regression? I don't know. It's the first time I have tried it. # Debug info - Streamlit version: 0.56.0 - Python version: 3.7.4 - Using Conda? PipEnv? PyEnv? Pex? Nope - OS version: MacOS 10.15.3 - Browser version: Safari 13.0.5 # Additional information **Code** ``` import pandas as pd import altair as alt df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 'b': [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]}) chart = alt.Chart(df).mark_line().encode( x='a', y='b' ) chart chart_dict = chart.to_dict() chart2 = alt.Chart.from_dict(chart_dict) chart2 ``` **Output** The same code renders correctly in Jupyter Notebook / Lab.
